messages:
Rina B.: Quick heads-up: PR #4198 adds a Node SDK snippet for streaming and updates the migration checklist for v2. I need a prose reviewer and a code reviewer. Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4198. Docs preview shows linkcheck failures from the bot. Hoping to get approvals so it can go in the 11:00 PT merge slot tomorrow.

Omar H.: I can take linkcheck + anchors. Saw a stale anchor in migration/checklist.md. If someone tags the commit I can push a small fix.

Priya S.: I'll review the migration checklist prose and make sure the steps are clear for engineers migrating on dedicated vs hosted.

Jules M.: I'll review the Node snippet. Noted that test harness currently uses a flaky integration run. I recommend swapping to a deterministic unit-style mock for the streaming iterator. Also please call out error codes in the example comments.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4198 (status: failing 010202 linkcheck: 1 broken anchor, 1 404)

Rina B.: Thanks 020202 the 404 is from an old example link I left in the checklist; fixed in a new commit and pushed. Omar, the anchor that broke was "migration-admins" in migration/checklist.md.

Omar H.: Got it, I patched the anchor rename and pushed. I'll re-run the link check locally to confirm.

Jules M.: I pushed a replacement test that uses a small fake stream object with predictable chunk yields and asserted final assembled text. Also added comments showing how to handle partial chunk errors and reconnect logic. Pushed to the branch.

Priya S.: Reviewed the migration prose; suggested one reorder for clarity around rolling restarts vs config toggles. Left a few line edits. Approving once small wording change applied.

Rina B.: I applied Priya's suggestion and updated CHANGELOG.md with one-line entry: "docs: v2 migration checklist and Node streaming snippet (PR #4198)".

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-4198 (status: passing)

Jules M.: Looks good, approved. Added a note in the snippet about expected JSON shapes and error obj fields.

Omar H.: Linkcheck and anchors look clean. Approved.

Priya S.: Approved. :white_check_mark:

Rina B.: Thanks everyone. Who will merge during the 11:00 PT window? I'm on a call then.

Omar H.: I can merge and handle backport if product asks for a release branch. I'll also add a short entry to release-notes.md just in case.

Rina B.: Perfect 020202 I'll monitor post-merge preview and verify redirects. If any quick fixes needed I'll raise a follow-up PR. Thanks y'all!
